weeks.title: Acting Foundations: Elements and principles of art
weeks.instructor_overview: Introduce and develop elements and principles of art within the context of Acting Foundations. Use explicit instruction, worked examples or models, guided practice, and independent application.

Create or analyze work using intentional artistic choices.
Reflect on process, technique, and revision.
